translations.translatedText: # Wednesday 9.5.2018 (radio)
Drugs from the internet. Preventing suicides. Sleep problems. Berries as medicine. The nice weather continues.
## Finns buy drugs online
![Drugs for sale on the hidden TOR network marketplace.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-10196804)
Open image viewer
Drugs for sale on the hidden TOR network marketplace. Photo: Irene Stachon / Lehtikuva
Buying drugs online is more common in Finland than elsewhere. In an international study, almost every second Finnish user says that they have bought drugs online.

The purchases were made on the hidden Tor network within the last year. In England, for example, one in four made such purchases online. In Finland, the most common drugs bought online are cannabis and ecstasy.
## The suicide prevention centre has been found
![A figure stands by a lake shore.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-5895028)
Open image viewer
The centre gives help to people who have attempted suicide. Photo: Anssi Leppänen / Yle
People who need help have found the suicide prevention centre. The centre opened in Helsinki in March.
It has already received almost 100 contacts. The youngest client has been 13 years old and the oldest 80. You can come to the suicide prevention centre without a referral.

The centre uses a therapy developed in Switzerland. Researchers have found that it reduces the risk of a suicide attempt. The centre offers support and help to people who have attempted suicide, to their loved ones, and to the relatives of people who have died by suicide.
## Sleep problems are common
![Insomnia.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-7534171)
Open image viewer
Very many people suffer from sleep problems. Photo: Yle
More and more people who suffer from sleep problems are coming to doctors' appointments. According to a study, 25 percent of women and 20 percent of men suffer from long-lasting sleep problems.

According to a researcher, the figures are alarming, and something must be done about them. The researcher says that everyday tiredness is experienced very much, to the point that tiredness has become the main thing people talk about.
## Berries have an effect on health
![Blueberries](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-9801735)
Open image viewer
Medicine may perhaps come from berries. Photo: Mari Vesanummi / Yle

New health effects have been found from the colourings of berries. A study from the University of Eastern Finland says that new medicines could perhaps be developed from the colourings of berries, that is, anthocyanins.

Medicines could perhaps be developed for treating pancreatic cancer and colon cancer, for example. The study says that anthocyanins increase the activity of sirtuins in cancer cells. Sirtuins may, for example, protect against cancer.
## Beautiful weather continues
![Wednesday's weather map.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-10196828)
Open image viewer
The sun shines across Finland. Photo: Yle
The sunny and warm weather continues. The sun will shine over a large part of the country from a cloudless sky for the working week.

Temperatures will rise a little more each day, so that at the weekend it may already be 25 degrees in the south. Even in Lapland the temperature will rise to around 20 degrees in the coming days, and the last snow in the north will melt quickly.
